pages.text: Eight slimeballs and one soul sand or soul soil produce your first companion.

A Friendly Slime starts in Wait. Select Follow in management, raise its stats and name it. Recover it to specialize later; first specialization also waits and retains traits.$(br2)Feed one golden apple to a tiny wild Slime to turn it into one owned Friendly Slime in Wait. Shift-right-click to recover it.
